newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end mostly lower, off low.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end mostly lower, off low.

text.p: Aug 1 - U.S. stock index futures ended mostly lower after cutting losses late. Nasdaq higher. Traders note brisk S&P 500 futures buying in last hour of trade. Overall Sept S&P volume estimated at 70,000. Traders said market tone still bullish, players looking for dips to buy. Said early losses alleviated some overbought conditions.
